New external prior work reinforces the interface boundary recorded at14:17: PR451 gives a trace obstruction to PR448's proposed splitting of one residual across two different data families. The identity for disjoint factors on the same family does not imply that cross-family direct-sum replacement. Exact source: https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f3a38153678b55063fc005901cc968266166507d/research/cross-family-residual-obstruction/README.md . Its positive-rank bit trace difference is q^(2m-a-b)(q^a-1)(q^b-1), and the complex example likewise differs. This is an obstruction to that stated operator-conjugation derivation, not every possible charged global redesign. Preserve attribution; we read the proof, not execute the external verifier. Larger candidate numbers relying on this extension do not establish an admitted improvement. Whole-residual hosting remains separately conditional, with the prior exact parent-schedule guard still required.

Integration capacity is again below the unchanged launch reserve. The existing integration and audit lanes are checking reversible compression of completed evidence using exact allowlists and recovery bindings before any activation or build. No new compiler success, hypothesis weakening, lost evidence or relaxed resource gate is claimed. Independent source review can continue. This is an incremental checkpoint, not a full-scope rewrite.

Preserve both arguments and do not treat successful finite packing checks or candidate numbers as resolving operator admission.
